Section 3 identifies the issuing body as 'República de Chile Servicio Nacional de Geología y Minería'. The form includes fields for consignor, consignee, ship details, bill of lading, quantity, and a certificate section (10) where the Servicio Nacional de Geología y Minería certifies the nitrate's composition, including natural Chilean sodium nitrate and potassium nitrate, with a nitrogen content limit of 16.3% by weight. Section 11 is reserved for EU customs authorities.

final_report.overview: Wood powder qualifies as wood flour for tariff-heading purposes when not more than 8% by weight is retained by a sieve with an aperture of 0.63 mm.
